subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Which boundary should own the combined recovery contract for compaction timeout, session liveness, and duplicate Telegram-visible delivery?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but a complete repair needs a maintainer-approved boundary across compaction timeout progress, session terminal state, scheduler/lane behavior, and outbound idempotency so valid repeat sends are not suppressed and delivered replies are not replayed.

options.title: Keep combined canonical and coordinate linked fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open as the combined tracker while maintainers review the focused compaction PR and split or land the Telegram/outbound and lane-starvation work with shared acceptance proof.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical issues
options.body: Move the remaining work entirely to the compaction-progress, lane-starvation, and duplicate-Telegram umbrellas, preserving this issue as context but not the main tracker.

options.title: Limit scope to compaction timeout only
options.body: Treat outbound duplicate delivery as separately owned and resolve this issue only when compaction timeout no longer wedges the session.

recommendation.title: Keep combined canonical and coordinate linked fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the combined tracker while maintainers review the focused compaction PR and split or land the Telegram/outbound and lane-starvation work with shared acceptance proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has adjacent compaction/session recovery history near the affected runtime path.
